description: Shows a registered Open Design artifact to the user in a live browser preview: an app window of their installed Chrome, Edge or Chromium (else their default browser; else it returns the URL to open). The preview reloads whenever the design's files change. In its Comment mode the user clicks an element to leave a comment with a screenshot; its Send to agent button copies an instruction for them to paste here, and get_open_design_artifact returns the comments. Its Checks panel shows the screenshots of each check_open_design_artifact run, before and after. Call it once per session after the first register_open_design_artifact, unless the user declined; later calls switch the same window to another artifact. Omit entryPath for a list of the workspace's designs. Pass open: false to only get the URL.

entryPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the registered artifact's entry file. Omit for the list of designs.

open.description: Open a window (default true). false only starts the preview and returns its URL.

name: open_open_design_preview
